outcome: For one explicitly selected construction subject, give its Work Owner a deterministic, source-current assessment that rejects skipped, stale, non-reproducible, or unaccepted transitions from definitions through product meaning, DomainSpec v2, system ontology, implementation, and claimed conformance.
scope: Check one CAV2-D65 ConstructionBinding and report evidence without changing the binding, its sources, lifecycle, authority, or implementation target.
exclusions: admitting a DomainSpec profile or system ontology
activating a Governance Constitution or rule
granting implementation, publication, deployment, or external-effect authority
claiming repository-wide implementation conformance from one registered subject

owner_routes.owner: Owner of the selected implementation subject

owner.value: Governance product, model, construction validator, DomainSpec compiler, and selected implementation owners

revision_history.change: Created the first Governance-owned CAV2-D67 record for deterministic D65 construction assessment.
revision_history.owner_route: Governance product ontology owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 governance-model owner

challenge_route: Challenge D65 meaning through definitions-governance, product meaning through the Governance product owner, DomainSpec compilation through the DomainSpec v2 owner, and implementation binding through the selected implementation and conformance owners.
claim_limit: Schema-conforming candidate Product Capability record and bounded implementation intent only; no adoption, admitted system ontology, accepted implementation baseline, conformance verdict, rule activation, enforcement effect, publication, release, or deployment.
